patterns.note: The primary content experience is a scroll-triggered narrative where individual lines of text appear centered on the screen, hold, and then fade out as the next line fades in, creating a poetic sequence.
The homepage features an immersive, full-bleed video background that persists throughout the main scroll experience, providing a continuous visual backdrop for the text narrative.

There is a dramatic contrast in typography, with extremely large, centered sans-serif text used for the main narrative, juxtaposed against much smaller, understated sans-serif text for supplementary information and the footer.
The site predominantly uses a high-contrast palette of white text on a dark, rich background, accented by a warm reddish-brown for secondary pages and footer elements.
The homepage is structured as a single, long-form, scroll-driven experiential section dedicated to a narrative, followed by a concise, static footer section.

technique_notes: The core motion system involves synchronizing the appearance and disappearance of text lines with scroll depth. As the user scrolls, each line of a poetic narrative is revealed with a fade-in animation, holds its position, and then fades out to make way for the subsequent line, creating a cinematic reading experience.
A full-bleed video hero plays continuously in the background, providing an immersive and dynamic visual context that remains consistent as the text narrative unfolds over it.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, centered display text (~8-10x body) with a clean, modern sans-serif for the narrative, contrasting sharply with small, understated body and footer text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and open, especially for the main scroll experience where text lines are isolated; the footer is more balanced but still not dense.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly immersive, scroll-driven narrative experience. It uses a full-bleed video background combined with a poetic, line-by-line text reveal and fade-out, creating a cinematic and emotionally engaging journey rather than a typical informational scroll.
